title: Mobility options for walking days
intro: Soft CTAs for established Dutch rail and mobility options when a hiking or walking day needs a train hub, trailhead car share or local bike. Confirm live products on each site — this block is not a ranking of trails, parks, tour operators or gear shops. Deepen OV planning on the Weekend travel sibling guide.

items.reason: Dutch Railways tickets and planners when your walk starts from a station hub — open Weekend travel for leisure OV planning depth.
